summary: Run on 2026-10-19 with tools/check.mjs (Playwright) against this site: every page at 1440 and 320 px, a full keyboard walkthrough, hover intent, the drawer at 390 and 320 px (focus in, Tab wrap, Esc, Close, scrim, inert, scroll lock), JavaScript switched off, and axe-core (WCAG 2.2 AA plus best practice) on every page at desktop and phone width with a menu open. 213 of 213 checks passed, with no console errors or warnings and no horizontal scroll at 320 px. Edge was not installed on the test machine; it runs the same Chromium engine as Chrome.
rows: Not run separately: same engine as Chrome above
